methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
OSH Cut is a bootstrapped robotics and manufacturing company founded by Caleb and Jacom Chamberlain. The valuation universe comprises 10 sector peers: 1 public company (277810.KQ) and 8 private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this analysis. The target's bootstrapped stage and valuation tier lack sufficient comparable datapoints within the robotics and manufacturing sector. While 10 same-sector peers exist, none satisfy the filtering criteria of matching stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier at the minimum threshold of three datapoints. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material distortion and is therefore unsuitable for triangulation.

Without a viable median-based approach, this analysis cannot support a specific valuation range grounded in the provided data. The narrow peer set at OSH Cut's particular stage and capitalization level—combined with the absence of transaction comps or financial performance metrics—leaves triangulation incomplete. A credible valuation would require either expansion of comparable datapoints within the robotics sector, disclosure of OSH Cut's revenue or comparable transaction multiples, or alternative methods such as DCF anchored to specific growth assumptions. The key uncertainty is the lack of quantitative benchmarking material necessary to establish value.
